strings.A dashed line marks 100% (reported = cou: A dashed line marks 100% (reported = counted tokens).
strings.Billing ratio = tokens the relay reports: Billing ratio = tokens the relay reports ÷ tokens ekte counted. Above 100%: the relay reports more tokens than ekte counted (you may be billed for more). ekte's counts are estimates, so small deviations are normal.

strings.Does this relay get slower or fail more: Does this relay get slower or fail more at peak hours? Each cell is one hour of one weekday in your time zone, coloured by the median of the runs that started then (scale below the grid).
